newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Hayleys up 4.55 pct as buying returns.
newsitem.headline: Hayleys up 4.55 pct as buying returns.

text.p: Shares of blue chip conglomerate Hayleys Ltd rose 4.55 percent or 10 rupees to 230 early on Monday, brokers said.
"Buying has returned to the scrip which fell to 220 rupees on Friday on profit-taking, after rising to 242 in the recent rally," said a local broker.
The share rose sharply from around 135 rupees in the recent rally which ended on April 23.

Colombo stocks moved up on improved investor sentiment due to better growth expectations, falling interest rates and a deal between the government and opposition to work together to end the ethnic conflict.
